title: Lamb Tagine with Indian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb tagine inspired by Indian cuisine, made with crispy onions and nutty spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb pieces on all sides, then set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté crispy onions until golden brown.
Add coriander powder, tagine spice blend, and brown sugar; stir for 1 minute.
Add lamb back into the pot, then pour in chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours or until lamb is tender.
Stir in yogurt and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve lamb hot, garnished with crispy onions and a side of rice or naan bread.
